svg.title: Multi-agent broker end-to-end
svg.desc: The broker control plane from intake and routing through isolated execution, deterministic checks, independent review, approval, and audit.

text.textPath: Stable company roles • Dynamic model assignment • Independent second voice • Deterministic evidence • Human authority

g.text: Final authority to pause, reject, merge or release
One role owns one deliverable • no self-approval • read-only by default
Evidence over confidence • least privilege • sequential until proven safe
Each phase returns a fixed handoff before the next phase begins

text.textPath: B. BROKER CONTROL PLANE — SOFTWARE-ENFORCED MANAGEMENT

g.text: Roles stay stable; Claude and Codex are replaceable workers
Read-only planning/review • write access only in assigned worktree • no push/merge/deploy
Broker-tracked usage • manual capacity overrides • latency • reliability • cache advantage
Only approved inputs for the current role; stable project memory stays in repository docs

text.textPath: C. ONE WORK UNIT — DYNAMIC CLAUDE/CODEX EXECUTION + QUALITY CONVERGENCE

g.text: Retry; never let reviewer silently fix
Release Manager assembles evidence; authorized human decides
SRE • Support • Success • BI feed outcomes back to Product

text.textPath: Animation: elements reveal in business order. In Excalidraw Animate, select elements to adjust Order and Duration.

g.text: Hard rule: deterministic failures or unresolved blockers cannot be outvoted.
